qa_pairs.question: What are the object storage endpoints for the legacy and new Arbutus Clouds, and what key differences should users be aware of regarding object storage in the new cloud?
qa_pairs.answer: The Legacy Arbutus Cloud Object Storage Endpoint is `https://object-arbutus.cloud.computecanada.ca`, and the New Arbutus Cloud Object Storage Endpoint is `https://object-arbutus.alliancecan.ca`. Key differences include that user and project UUIDs will change, and the new cloud's object storage uses tenants, so bucket name collisions will only occur within individual projects. For public access to buckets without authentication, the tenant must be explicitly specified in the URL.

qa_pairs.question: Which tool is recommended for migrating object storage data to the new Arbutus Cloud, and what implications does its use have for bucket Access Control Lists (ACLs)?
qa_pairs.answer: The document recommends using rclone for migrating object storage data. When using rclone, users should be aware that it will not copy bucket ACLs, meaning all access will initially be defaulted as private in the new location. It is generally advised to check if any migration tool copies bucket ACLs correctly, as most do not preserve them, requiring users to recreate them in the new environment.
